## SETTLEMENT\_FEE\_BREAKPOINTS variable

Settlement-fee time-to-maturity breakpoints in seconds.

Midnight linearly interpolates each market's seven settlement-fee cbp buckets across these breakpoints.

**Signature:**

```typescript
SETTLEMENT_FEE_BREAKPOINTS: readonly [0n, bigint, bigint, bigint, bigint, bigint, bigint]
```

## Example


```ts
import { SETTLEMENT_FEE_BREAKPOINTS } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

console.log(SETTLEMENT_FEE_BREAKPOINTS[1]);
```
